item.title: Imouto ~Mitsutsubo: Dai Nishou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mink EGO
  • 発売日: 2018-01-26
  • スコア: 6.529999999999999/10 (41 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いもうと ～蜜壺・第二章～
  • 英語名: Imouto Mitsutsubo: Dai Nishou

别名

  • Mink Final Best Memorialパック

あらすじ

Tooru, the main character, returns home for the first time in a while and reunites with Mitsuka, his younger sister, who has grown into a beautiful woman.

“A feeling rekindled in my heart when I saw her. But also a deep sadness. I remember the guilt of lusting after my own sister. I left my hometown because of it and decided to love another woman. I was supposed to have come to announce my engagement with Saori… but my resolve is shattered by my sister’s sweet temptation.”

item.title: Toumei Ningen - Iregui Chuuzou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mink EGO
  • 発売日: 2017-09-29
  • スコア: 6.05/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 透明人間 挿れ喰い仲三
  • 英語名: Toumei Ningen - Iregui Chuuzou

あらすじ

The protagonist, Hirumada Chuuzou, a chemistry teacher at the private Narumizawa Academy, has been secretly researching a drug that turn people invisible. However, he is fired after it is discovered that he is using school equipment for his personal research, and his previous sexual harassment behavior has also become an issue. When Hirumada came to pack up his belongings, he drank the newly completed drug, becoming invisible and taking up residence at the school. Taking advantage of the fact that he was invisible, he engaged in lewd acts as revenge against the girls who have made fun of him and the school, and to satisfy his own desires.

The only thriving area was in front of the station, and the rest was just dirt roads as far as the eye could see - a typical rural area.

あらすじ

Sakaki Hina. Not only her face but also her big breasts and style is perfect. She is short and small, but also cute and charming. Her personality is bright, innocent and healthy. She was a cute “younger sister” who went to the same private school as Momo.

One day, my younger sister confesses to me. She loved me as the opposite sex. It was the same for me… We became “lovers” that day.

别名

あらすじ

“Playing siblings with a complete stranger… Then there’s no need for self-restraint, right?”

The girl I just met said it cheerfully with a carefree smile, as if she were just an old friend inviting me for a detour on the way home from school. With lovely mannerisms, like reciting from a favorite poem collection, the girl lured me.

item.title: Onii-chan ni wa Zettai Ienai Taisetsu na Koto.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mink EGO
  • 発売日: 2013-01-11
  • スコア: 7.33/10 (101 人評価)
  • 日本語名: お兄ちゃんにはぜったい言えないたいせつなこと。
  • 英語名: Onii-chan ni wa Zettai Ienai Taisetsu na Koto.

别名

  • onitai

あらすじ

“Hey, Onii-chan. Let’s make our dream come true, no matter what.”

With those words, my younger sister smiles happily beside me.

Beneath a winter sky that stings the skin. Our breath comes out white, yet huddled close together, we’re warm to the point of ticklishness.

Today as well, we speak of tomorrow as if it were a continuation of yesterday, weaving our shared dream.
